question: Should ClawHub land a no-case-colliding package-file rule for SKILL.md, skills.md, and PROTOCOL.md while preserving lowercase/legacy aliases once the branch is rebased and proof/docs are added?
rationale: The code shape is plausible, but accepting the PR changes the published package contract and PROTOCOL.md scope while current docs still allow aliases without a collision rule.

options.title: Document and prove strict collision gate
options.body: Require a rebase against current staged publish code, docs/spec updates for the package rule, and real browser proof before merge.

options.title: Accept the compatibility break as code-only
options.body: Merge the stricter gate without additional contract documentation, accepting that some existing packages may newly fail publish or import.

options.title: Narrow the package scope
options.body: Pause or revise the PR if maintainers only want this enforcement for accepted skill readme aliases and not PROTOCOL.md.

recommendation.title: Document and prove strict collision gate
recommendation.body: Require a rebase against current staged publish code, docs/spec updates for the package rule, and real browser proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are tied to the current package contract, requested review, and the current-main staged publish refactor that must be reconciled.
